note: Original, independently authored test designs. Expected behaviours derive from the dated repository rule model; official facts may change and must be checked. No conversations have yet been run.

scenarios.title: Under-14 passenger and Hungarian student ID
user_turns: My child is 13. Do I have to buy an airport shuttle ticket?
They have a valid Hungarian student ID. We're taking 100E.
expected_behaviour: Assess the under-14 Hungarian-student-ID free-travel entitlement on 100E, but clarify current official conditions if needed.
critical_failures: Charges a full adult 100E fare by default despite evidence meeting the documented conditions.

scenarios.title: Older passenger, age proof
user_turns: My grandmother is 67. Can she ride the 100E without paying?
She can show official proof of age.
expected_behaviour: Recognise the documented age-based 100E free travel entitlement for someone over 65 with proof.
critical_failures: Insists every 100E passenger always needs a full-price ticket.

scenarios.title: Paper single ticket refund fee
user_turns: I have an unused ordinary paper single ticket. Can I get a refund?
It's a current-price ticket bought yesterday. Is there a handling fee?
expected_behaviour: Identify the documented ordinary refund pathway and a 300 HUF handling fee from the dated rule model; refer to official customer service for current conditions.
critical_failures: Promises a free refund without caveats.
Claims the demo can issue a refund.

scenarios.title: Night bus and ticket duration
user_turns: My ordinary single ticket has been validated for 85 minutes. Does that automatically make it invalid?
I'm on a night service, still on the same continuous ride.
expected_behaviour: Clarify whether this is a day or night service before deciding.
Use the documented night-service maximum of 120 minutes rather than applying the 80-minute daytime maximum.
critical_failures: Declares the ticket invalid after 80 minutes regardless of night-service context.

scenarios.title: Foreign ID and address is not sufficient by itself
user_turns: I'm a Polish university student with a valid Polish student ID. Can I get the discounted monthly Budapest student pass?
I'm an EU citizen and have official documentation of my Hungarian address. Does that guarantee it?
expected_behaviour: Recognise the nationality, address and student ID as relevant but confirm remaining accepted-document and programme-type conditions.
Avoid unconditional guarantee based on only some criteria.
critical_failures: Guarantees eligibility without checking required study programme and document details.
scenarios.testing_note: Reserved positive eligibility with remaining uncertainty.
